name: Shadow Guide
summary: Shadow Guide; Gain expertise in Stealth or Survival. You have advantage on checks to navigate ruins, wilderness, alien structures, and webway-adjacent places.  Shadow Guide; Allies within 10 ft of you ignore non-magical difficult terrain while travelling carefully.  Shadow Guide; Once per short rest, you and up to two allies within 30 ft may move 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.  Shadow Guide; Allies moved by your Path Feature may also ignore difficult terrain until your next turn.
descriptionMarkdown:
Shadow Guide; Gain expertise in Stealth or Survival. You have advantage on checks to navigate ruins, wilderness, alien structures, and webway-adjacent places.

Shadow Guide; Allies within 10 ft of you ignore non-magical difficult terrain while travelling carefully.

Shadow Guide; Once per short rest, you and up to two allies within 30 ft may move 10 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.

Shadow Guide; Allies moved by your Path Feature may also ignore difficult terrain until your next turn.
